newsitem.title: CHINA: PT Bank Putra Surya Perkasa to launch $25mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: PT Bank Putra Surya Perkasa to launch $25mln FRCD.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Bank Putra Surya Perkasa is expected to launch a US$25 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue on Thursday, arranger AB Capital Markets (HK) said.
The issue will be divided into two tranches.
Tranche A has a maturity of three years with a put option at the end of year two while tranche B has two years maturity.
Both tranches will pay a coupon of 140 basis points over the Singapore Interbank Offered Rate. There is a put waiver fee of 125 basis points for tranche A.

Fees are 160 basis points for co-lead managers committing US$5 million and above, 130 basis points for senior managers committing US$3 million and above, and 110 basis points for managers committing US$1 million and above.
Bank Putra Surya Perkasa is the seventh largest private bank in Indonesia and a member of the Putra Surya Perkasa group, one of the 30 largest conglomerates in the country.
